Can you keep the avocado tree on a large pot? Will it give fruit?

I don't have terrain in my home to plant stuff, so I keep everything on pots. Would love to be able to have fruit trees.

From what I've read, yes, they can be kept in a large pot. In fact, you may have to move them indoors if the temperature is set to drop below 45 degrees.

As to fruit, I've read that it takes a long time for the plant to reach the level of maturity needed for fruit. It may never produce fruit at all. But, nothing ventured, nothing gained.

From my experience, this is what worked for me:

  1. Peel all skin off of the seed, might have to soak it in water for a bit to get it to come off cleanly.
  2. Toothpicks work fine for me.
  3. Heating pad is not required however, it does appear to speed up the process.
  4. Make sure to change water every 4-5 days to prevent foggy, moldy water.
  5. Direct sunlight is supposedly not great for them, but on nice days ill take my seeds outside.
  6. Constantly touching them seems to not be great for them either.
